title: potentilla arenaria subvar. parviflora
intro: Potentilla arenaria subvar. parviflora, commonly known as the Small-Flowered Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of P. arenaria subvar. parviflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of P. arenaria subvar. parviflora for medicinal use.
